marketing_wrapper: Very marketing-heavy. 01 and 02 form one panorama of a tilted, older-generation phone (speaker-slot bezel) on a #007aff blue field; they are the only frames with in-app UI (main forecast; radar). 03 is pure marketing (slogan + award laurels). 04 shows home-screen widgets, 05 system notifications plus a red explainer callout, 06 an Apple Watch face. Under 25% of the total pixels are in-app UI, and those frames appear to show a pre-'Glassy Redesign' build.

typography.display: SF Pro Rounded bold for captions and the city name; large light/regular SF numerals for the current temperature (72°)
typography.body: system SF (Rounded in the forecast quip line, which is set large and bold-ish as the hero copy)
typography.numerals: rounded/proportional in app; the watch face and widget forecast rows use bold tabular-looking SF numerals
typography.weights: Bold rounded for headings and quip; light for the hero temperature; semibold for hourly temps
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence/title case; hourly labels abbreviated 8A/10A/12P; watch face uses all-caps condition text (PARTLY SUNNY) and day names

palette.accent_strategy: Condition-flooded: the main screen background is a saturated sky blue tied to the current condition, with white text and a flat illustrated landscape; colourful filled weather glyphs (orange sun, purple night cloud) carry per-hour state. Radar uses the standard green-yellow-red precip ramp. Marketing yellow is a brand accent.
palette.source: palette.json 01: #007aff 35% and #0091fe = marketing field and in-app sky (visually very close), #fffffd = hourly sheet, #b8f0c8 / #40a5cc = illustrated hills; 02: #1d3579 / #01617c = radar basemap, #000000 = dark segmented header; 03: yellow from marketing. Accent hexes for glyphs are visual estimates.

shape.radius_language: small to medium: ~10pt rounded square map buttons on radar, ~22pt widget tiles, a segmented control with ~8pt corners
shape.borders_shadows: Flat; dark translucent square buttons on radar; no visible shadows in-app
shape.materials: Flat vector illustration; dark translucent controls over the map

liquid_glass_visible: no (the frames shown predate or don't show the 6.3 glassy redesign)
density: low on the main forecast (hero temp, one quip, illustration, then hourly row); high on the watch face and widgets (multi-complication grid)
layout: Main screen: city name, circular overflow button, large flat sun icon beside the temperature and feels-like, the persona quip as a full-width bold sentence, an illustrated hillside horizon, then a white hourly panel with icons plotted at heights matching temperature.
navigation: Overflow (…) circle top-right; Radar/Forecast segmented control on the map screen with floating square map buttons (share, location, layers, eyedropper). No tab bar visible.
imagery_and_icons: Flat vector illustration (sun with pointed rays, rolling hills, a small observatory/robot structure, trees), filled multicolour weather glyphs, CARROT's purple cloud-face app icon in notifications.
signature_visual_move: The forecast is a sentence: the persona's quip sits as large bold hero copy under the temperature, over a flat illustrated hillside.

direction_fit.why: The only in-app frame confirms the voice-borne character as hero copy; the rest is widgets, notifications and watch faces, so the 6.x garden/glassy visual layer can't be judged.

notes: Store set is stale relative to the 6.3 'Glassy Redesign' and the 6.0 garden; the tilted phone has a home-button-era earpiece. Treat visual fields as low confidence until a device capture exists.
